meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: Claude 会往 NanoClaw 的 agent 容器里装 Vercel CLI,并配置 OneCLI 自动注入 Vercel 凭据,让 agent 能把网页应用部署到 Vercel、查看部署列表。
howto.when: 当你想让 agent 把网页应用部署到 Vercel 时触发;若检测到 OneCLI 未就绪,会先让你运行 /init-onecli 再重试。

say.text: 帮我把这个网页应用部署到 Vercel 生产环境
列出我在 Vercel 上的部署记录
这是我的 Vercel token,帮我配置好
say.note: 写入 OneCLI 并分配给所有 agent

howto.what_en: Claude installs the Vercel CLI into NanoClaw agent containers and configures OneCLI to inject Vercel credentials, so agents can deploy web apps to Vercel and list deployments.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want an agent to deploy a web application to Vercel. If OneCLI is missing, it asks you to run /init-onecli first, then retry.

say_en.text: Deploy this web app to Vercel production
Here's my Vercel token, set it up
say_en.note: Stores it in OneCLI and assigns it to all agents
